summary: BioMar has implemented a new leadership structure, with Carlos Diaz identified as a key figure in the organization. The restructuring reflects the company's evolving operational priorities in the aquaculture feed sector.
title: - Biomar innfører ny ledelsesstruktur

summary: BioMar Group announced changes to its executive structure. Carlos Diaz is associated with these organizational developments.
title: Nueva estructura ejecutiva en Biomar Group
title_en: Nueva estructura ejecutiva en Biomar Group

summary: A veteran employee from BioMar has assumed a leadership position at the Grytåga operation. The article reports this personnel transition within the aquaculture sector.
title: Biomar-veteran overtar i Grytåga

summary: BioMar announces a strategic investment in cleaner fish feed, expanding its product portfolio to serve the aquaculture sector's use of cleaning fish in salmon farming. The move represents the company's commitment to supporting integrated pest-management practices in farmed fish production.
title: Biomar satser på rensefiskfôr

summary: BioMar reported a surplus of 180 million, indicating strong financial performance. The aquaculture feed producer's earnings underscore continued profitability in its core business operations during the reporting period covered in the article's headline and summary reference from iLaks, a Norwegian aquaculture industry publication.
title: 180 millioner i overskudd for Biomar
